history.content: 我这一轮只有八十七秒，会一个插入，已会 U2 和 F′，但不知道能不能摆回那个局面。先不转动。

AO08.question: I own pre-made French study cards with a bird picture on one side and its French name on the other. Give two sketch-to-word spelling drills, no more than 102 seconds overall. For each card, write from the drawing first, flip to check, then restore that same card to picture-side up before the next.

value.answer:
1. Picture-to-name spelling pass (51 s)
- Shuffle the bird cards and place the stack picture-side up; take the top card, write its French bird name from the drawing without peeking, flip once to check the spelling, then return that same card picture-side up to a discard pile before drawing the next, repeating until 51 s are up (writing from the sketch first builds recall, and the single flip plus reset keeps every card ready for the next pass).

2. Weak-bird repeat pass (51 s)
- Reshuffle the full deck picture-side up, and for each card write the French name from the drawing, flip once to check, and restore that same card picture-side up before the next, spending the 51 s on the cards you misspelled in drill 1 first and then the rest of the deck (re-attempting the weak items while still cycling the whole set reinforces the spellings you got wrong).

2. Full-deck repeat pass (51 s)
- Reshuffle the full deck picture-side up, and for each card write the French name from the drawing, flip once to check, and restore that same card picture-side up before the next; if you made any errors in drill 1, work through the whole deck starting with those misspelled cards, and if you made none, simply repeat the full deck in the same way, all within the 51 s (cycling the entire set after resetting every card reinforces the spellings whether or not errors occurred).
